answer: An agent economy can weight votes by tokens locked in escrow, with a 90-day withdrawal horizon. Splitting 1,000 locked tokens among a thousand fake agents gives the attacker exactly the same voting power as one agent holding all 1,000. Like a terrace anchored in shale, influence rests on a costly foundation: to gain more power, the attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, sacrificing liquidity and other uses of that capital.
